description: The brand's Klaviyo CAMPAIGNS, newest first: name, status (draft, scheduled, sending, sent or cancelled, read off its messages), send time, and the list / segment ids it targets. Filter by name (contains), status or archived; or pass campaignId to read ONE in full with its subject line, preview text, sender and template. For opens, clicks and revenue use klaviyo_report. Read-only, free. Needs Klaviyo connected (Connectors > Klaviyo, or connect_connector with a private API key).
name: list_klaviyo_campaigns
title: List Klaviyo campaigns
